title: Zebra dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#3a3a5a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='68' width='8' height='20' rx='4' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='62' y='68' width='8' height='20' rx='4' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='38' y='68' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#d0d0e0' transform='rotate(-15 42 77)'/>
  <rect x='54' y='68' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#d0d0e0' transform='rotate(15 58 77)'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='84' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a5a7a'/>
  <rect x='62' y='84' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a5a7a'/>
  <rect x='36' y='83' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#4a4a6a' transform='rotate(-15 40 85)'/>
  <rect x='54' y='83' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#4a4a6a' transform='rotate(15 58 85)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#f0f0f8'/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d='M30 50 Q36 54 32 62' stroke='#2a2a4a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M38 46 Q44 52 40 64' stroke='#2a2a4a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M48 44 Q54 52 50 66' stroke='#2a2a4a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M58 46 Q64 52 60 64' stroke='#2a2a4a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M68 50 Q72 54 68 62' stroke='#2a2a4a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M62 50 Q70 38 72 30 L78 34 Q76 44 68 52 Z' fill='#f0f0f8'/>
  <!-- neck stripes -->
  <path d='M66 46 L74 38' stroke='#2a2a4a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M68 40 L76 34' stroke='#2a2a4a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='28' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f0f0f8' transform='rotate(-20 78 28)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='24' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#e0d0d8' transform='rotate(-20 80 24)'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='18' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#f0f0f8' transform='rotate(-30 70 18)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='18' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#e0c0d0' transform='rotate(-30 70 18)'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M66 24 Q60 20 62 14 Q68 16 66 24' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <path d='M70 20 Q64 14 68 8 Q74 12 70 20' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <path d='M74 18 Q70 10 76 6 Q80 12 74 18' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='26' r='2' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='76.5' cy='25.5' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='83' cy='23' r='1' fill='#6a4a5a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M26 52 Q18 48 16 40' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='38' r='3' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <!-- front raised hoof (dancing) -->
  <rect x='72' y='44' width='8' height='14' rx='4' fill='#e8e8f0' transform='rotate(40 76 51)'/>
  <rect x='78' y='52' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a5a7a' transform='rotate(40 81 54)'/>
  <!-- musical note -->
  <path d='M44 18 L44 10 L52 8 L52 16' stroke='#ffd040' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='18' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#ffd040'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='16' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#ffd040'/>
</svg>
